rendering: Target RNA cartoon with translucent nearby ribosomal context, FR3D-annotated residue-endpoint markers, and an in-panel legend

rendering_settings.protein_context: complete protein chains with atoms within 14 angstroms of the target RNA
rendering_settings.rna_context: single strongest neighboring RNA chain by local atom count within 12 angstroms of target; local-residue fallback if none
rendering_settings.camera: oriented on target RNA; 3.5 angstrom zoom buffer
rendering_settings.endpoint_markers: C1-prime atom spheres; FR3D residue sets kept disjoint

interpretation_limit: Highlighted residues are endpoints of FR3D geometric annotations. The rendering does not depict inferred hydrogen bonds or establish interactions absent from FR3D output.
distribution_note: The reference PNGs are supplied with the manuscript rather than duplicated in this repository. The public renderer regenerates them from the pinned mmCIF and FR3D evidence table; reference output checksums are recorded above.
